resources.contents:
openapi: "3.0.0"

info:
  title: Edubit API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: OpenAPI spec for Edubit's managed entities
  contact:
    name: HMCA

tags:
  - name: Admin
    description: All operations related with managed entities

components:
  schemas:
    PersistentActivity:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        name:
          type: string
        levels:
          type: integer
        description:
          type: string
        enabled:
          type: boolean
        creationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        modificationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        disabledDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - levels
        - description
        - enabled
        - creationDate
    PersistentAsset:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        title:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
        price:
          type: integer
        enabled:
          type: boolean
        creationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        modificationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        disabledDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
      required:
        - id
        - title
        - description
        - price
        - enabled
        - creationDate
    PersistentImprovement:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        name:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
        price:
          type: integer
        enabled:
          type: boolean
        creationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        modificationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        disabledDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - description
        - price
        - enabled
        - creationDate
    PersistentInstitution:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        name:
          type: string
        enabled:
          type: boolean
        creationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        modificationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        disabledDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - enabled
        - creationDate

servers:
  - url: https://{gateway}.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/{stage}/admin
    description: URL on AWS cloud
    variables:
      gateway:
        enum: [78vxincnn2]
        default: 78vxincnn2
      stage:
        enum: [dev, qa, live]
        default: dev

paths:
  /activities/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get activity
      description: Get all information of an activity
      operationId: getActivity
      tags:
        - Admin
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Participant successfully retrieved
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentActivity'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
    patch:
      summary: Update activity
      description: Updates partial information of an activity (name, levels, abilities, description)
      operationId: updateActivity
      tags:
        - Admin
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentActivity'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Participant successfully updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentActivity'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
    delete:
      summary: Disables participant
      description: Makes a logical deletion of a participant
      operationId: deleteParticipant
      tags:
        - Admin
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Participant successfully disabled
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
  /activities:
    get:
      summary: Get all activities
